tables.text_translated: LITHOLOGY AT 5,400 M: 80% LIGHT GRAY, LIGHT BROWN AND WHITE CREAM MUDSTONE, PARTLY DOLOMITIC, SLIGHTLY CLAYEY, SOME FRAGMENTS SHOW MICROSTYLOLITIC LINES SEALED BY BITUMINOUS CLAY MATERIAL, SOME FRAGMENTS SHOW ANHYDRITE PATCHES, SOME FRAGMENTS SHOW MICROFRACTURES SEALED BY CALCITE. 20% WHITE ANHYDRITE.
